project.name: CHB

principles: Cloud synchronization must not silently overwrite conflicts
Daily WorkDay records are the source of truth for work data
Tables are the primary daily work interface
Preferences use the centralized app settings layer
Generated Markdown is output; docs/data JSON is the source of truth
The application must remain usable on older hardware

issues.title: Experimental beer comparison can be confusing
issues.description: The experimental comparison may present values that are easy to interpret as day counts or strong conclusions when the sample is small.
issues.workaround: Treat CHB Intelligence as experimental and verify the sample-size labels.
issues.plannedResolution: Dedicated CHB Intelligence quality pass with clearer units, minimum sample sizes and confidence indicators.

issues.title: Production main chunk exceeds the Vite warning threshold
issues.description: The production bundle currently emits a chunk-size warning after minification.
issues.workaround: The warning does not block deployment.
issues.plannedResolution: Add route-level lazy loading and production code splitting during a later quality pass.

acceptedDecisions.title: Use a local-first data model
acceptedDecisions.context: CHB must remain usable without internet and on multiple devices.
acceptedDecisions.decision: Dexie is the primary local store; Supabase synchronizes snapshots without replacing local-first behavior.
consequences: UI updates do not wait for the network
Conflicts require safe comparison and explicit resolution
Cloud synchronization is debounced for older hardware

acceptedDecisions.title: Use WorkDay as the source of truth for daily work data
acceptedDecisions.context: Dashboard, Work and future statistics must calculate from identical records.
acceptedDecisions.decision: Paid messages, held messages, beers, rating and sessions are stored on WorkDay.
consequences: Weekly totals are derived from days
Dashboard edits the same records as the Work page
Legacy weekly heldMessages remains temporarily for compatibility

acceptedDecisions.title: Use tables as the primary daily work interface
acceptedDecisions.context: The user works faster in spreadsheet-like interfaces than in detached forms.
acceptedDecisions.decision: Daily work values are edited inline with keyboard navigation; forms are reserved for complex configuration.
consequences: Enter saves values
Table density is configurable
Future data-heavy modules should reuse the table system

acceptedDecisions.title: Centralize application preferences
acceptedDecisions.context: Preferences will expand to colors, tab order, layouts and future modules.
acceptedDecisions.decision: Components use appSettingsService and useAppSettings rather than reading Dexie directly.
consequences: Preferences are synchronized and backed up automatically
UI reacts to preference changes
Future settings share one architecture

acceptedDecisions.title: Use machine-readable project data as documentation source
acceptedDecisions.context: The roadmap and changelog are too large to maintain reliably by hand.
acceptedDecisions.decision: docs/data JSON is authoritative; Markdown and AI context files are generated outputs.
consequences: Documentation can be validated
Multiple AI providers can consume the same project interface
Manual edits to generated files are overwritten

acceptedDecisions.title: Keep the AI Project Interface vendor-neutral
acceptedDecisions.context: The project may later use Cursor, OpenAI, Anthropic, Copilot, Gemini, MCP or local models.
acceptedDecisions.decision: Use plain JSON, JSON Schema and generated Markdown without provider-specific requirements in the core.
consequences: Provider adapters can be added later
Project context remains portable
Core project data does not require an AI SDK

acceptedDecisions.title: Generate provider adapters from one AI Project Interface
acceptedDecisions.context: Different coding agents use different conventional context files.
acceptedDecisions.decision: Keep canonical context in docs/data and generate AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and Cursor rules as disposable adapters.
consequences: Provider files never become independent sources of truth
A new provider can be added without changing project data
Generated adapters are checked for drift in CI and release preparation
